guarantees.claim: keccak_data_o is assigned to msg_data_i when sel_mux == MuxFifo, to prefix_data when MuxPrefix, to funcpad_data when MuxFuncPad, to zero_with_endbit when MuxZeroEnd, and to all zeros otherwise.

The unique case with a default clause ensures keccak_data_o is driven to all zeros for any sel_mux value not matching the four explicit enumerated cases (including MuxNone and any 4-state illegal value), preventing latch inference.

assumptions.claim: When sel_mux selects a particular input source, the corresponding data signal (msg_data_i, prefix_data, funcpad_data, or zero_with_endbit) must be stable and valid on the same cycle; otherwise keccak_data_o will propagate invalid/corrupt data.
assumptions.risk: Downstream keccak core may process incorrect padding or data, potentially corrupting the final digest or enabling a security bypass.

uncertain_points.claim: If sel_mux ever takes an illegal or 4-state X value (due to an upstream fault or CDC glitch), the default case silently drives keccak_data_o to all zeros without setting any error flag or abort signal, allowing corrupted data to enter the Keccak pipeline.
uncertain_points.cond: sel_mux invalid or X in hardware
uncertain_points.risk: Undetected data corruption propagates to keccak_core and may result in an incorrect digest output with no alert raised.
